name: Viceroys
description: The Viceroys were a Puerto Rican street gang active in East Harlem during the 1950s. They were bitter enemies of the Dragons. On December 30, 1957, Feliciano (Felix) Sanchez, aka "Superman," a Viceroy member, stabbed and killed Robert Crossland in a grocery store on Park Avenue, apparently believing him to be a member of a rival gang called the Enchanters; Crossland denied the affiliation.

sources.title: "You are Who Hang With…" And other Notes of Gang Warfare Involving the Viceroys
